name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
summary: The row of tools above a workspace: leading, centered and trailing groups over a hairline.
use: For the actions and view toggles of a whole window.
rules: Ghost icon buttons; a toggle that shows a pane is on while the pane is open.
At most one primary button in a window, and it lives here or in a dialog.
Group related tools; separate groups with a toolbar divider.
accessibility: Every icon button has a label and a tooltip.
Tools keep a keyboard shortcut where the platform expects one.
